faqsSection.heading: Questions prospective clients ask before booking installation

faqs.question: Do I have to drive to a workshop for the installation?
faqs.answer: No. We send a technician to your home, office, school, warehouse, or any approved location within our service area. Most standard vehicle installations are completed on-site.

faqs.question: How quickly does the tracker update the vehicle location?
faqs.answer: Supported devices refresh location every few seconds when the vehicle is moving. This means you see near-live movement rather than delayed position snapshots.

faqs.question: Does the device keep operating after I switch the engine off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Supported installations run with auxiliary backup power and low-power standby modes, so reporting continues after ignition is turned off.

faqs.question: Can I watch several vehicles from a single login?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-vehicle access is standard on family, corporate, campus, and logistics accounts, with each vehicle appearing as a separate row on the dashboard.

faqs.question: Are there packages without recurring subscription fees?
faqs.answer: Some tracking tiers are structured as single-payment deployments. More advanced telematics, fleet analytics, and heavy-reporting plans typically include recurring service fees.

faqs.question: Can I stop the engine remotely if the vehicle is moved without permission?
faqs.answer: Eligible installations include hardware that supports remote immobilisation. Safety checks are part of the configuration so activation happens only under appropriate conditions.

faqs.question: What is the average time needed for installation?
faqs.answer: Standard single-vehicle deployments typically finish within 45 to 75 minutes. Advanced multi-device, fleet, or security-concealed setups take longer and are scheduled accordingly.

faqs.question: Will a tracker shorten the life of my car battery?
faqs.answer: No. Properly installed hardware operates at low-power levels and is configured to avoid parasitic drain. Backup power is used sparingly.

faqs.question: Can I monitor the vehicle when I am travelling outside Nigeria?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can log into the web or mobile interface from anywhere as long as the installed tracker has mobile network coverage within Nigeria.

faqs.question: Do you work with both personal vehicle owners and commercial fleets?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve private individuals, executive protection teams, school transport departments, corporate fleet managers, and logistics operations of different sizes.
